product.name: Coupons
product.description: Coupon codes for any checkout: shared or bulk single-use codes, eligibility rules, percent / fixed / free-shipping / BXGY / tiered / gift actions, usage limits and abuse controls, stacking, a drop-in or headless apply box, share links and QR codes, reporting, and an idempotent validate / quote / reserve / redeem / release API — all data in the merchant's own database.

elements.name: Coupon codes
elements.description: Coupons and their codes: one shared code or bulk unique codes from patterns (cryptographically random), single- or multi-use, validity windows (dates, weekdays, overnight times, any time zone), auto-apply links.

elements.name: Eligibility
elements.description: Who and what a coupon applies to: structured conditions (items, variants, collections, attributes, prices, quantities, subtotal, payment and delivery method, country, segments, first order, device, source; and/or groups) plus a rules@1 condition over cart, customer and context.

elements.name: Actions
elements.description: What a coupon takes off: percent (bounded 0–100 %), fixed amount (once or per unit), free shipping, buy X get Y, tiered by quantity or subtotal, gift item — rounded once, allocated to lines.

elements.name: Limits
elements.description: Uses per customer (bring-your-own identity) and per device, velocity limits on checks, failures and reservations, and a blocklist of customers, e-mails, devices and codes.

elements.name: Stacking
elements.description: Several coupons per cart: classes that combine (item / order / shipping or your own), exclusive coupons, priorities, best-discount or in-order selection, and loyalty / deals flags on every quote.

elements.name: Redemption API
elements.description: validate / quote / reserve / redeem / release for any checkout — idempotent, reservations with a TTL and atomic counters so concurrent checkouts never over-redeem a limited code; orders confirm, cancel and refund through the Event Hub.

elements.name: Apply box
elements.description: The code field of a cart or checkout: drop-in renderer on the website's design tokens, headless core for your own UI, auto-apply from links, live savings.

elements.name: Distribution
elements.description: Share links with the auto-apply parameter, QR codes as SVG generated by the product, CSV exports of codes.

elements.name: Reporting
elements.description: Redemptions, discount given, revenue and average order with coupons per currency, discount rate, undone redemptions, top codes and coupons.

plans.name: Starter
plans.description: Codes, eligibility, actions, limits, the redemption API and the apply box; stacking, distribution and reporting as add-ons.
